draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Malappuram! You're at Muttippalam, just 3 km from Manjeri, the fourth most populous municipality in Kerala. This whole area was once Eranad, the biggest taluk in British Malabar.
draft.hungryLine: I don't have a named eatery to point you to here, so ask around Manjeri town for a good meal.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Walk to St Joseph Church Manjeri, then the Arukizhaya Shiva Temple and the thurakkal jumua masjid, all close together.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Take an evening walk past the mosques, when people gather after prayers to talk over the day.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Many books in the mosque libraries here are written in Arabi-Malayalam, Malayalam written in the Arabic script.

spots.name: St Joseph Church Manjeri
spots.detail: 16 min walk · A church on the edge of Manjeri

spots.name: Arukizhaya Shiva Temple
spots.detail: 17 min walk · A local Shiva temple

legends.title: The evening gatherings
legends.body: People here gather in the mosques for evening prayer and stay on to talk. Business and family matters are often sorted out right there.

legends.title: Folk arts
legends.body: Duff Muttu, Kolkali and Aravanamuttu are the common folk arts of this area. They come from the local Muslim traditions.

tips.title: Go easy at prayer time.
tips.body: Evenings are when people fill the mosques for prayer and meetings, so keep it quiet nearby.

tips.title: Dress modestly.
tips.body: This is a traditional, mostly Muslim area with mosques, temples and churches close together.

story.title: Eranad's first capital
story.body: Eranad was ruled by the Eradis, a Samanthan Nair clan. Under Chera rule its capital was Nediyiruppu in Kondotty.

story.title: A new capital
story.body: When the Zamorin held sway, Eranad's capital moved to Kottappadi in Malappuram.

story.title: The biggest taluk
story.body: Ernad Taluk stretched between the Chaliyar and Kadalundi rivers, and it was the largest taluk in Malabar District.

story.title: A medical college
story.body: Government Medical College, Manjeri, opened on 1 September 2013, the sixth government medical college in Kerala.

story.title: Your turn
story.body: Walk Muttippalam's lanes, then head into Manjeri, now the headquarters of Eranad Taluk. Tell me what you find.
